How Hollow Creek works

Each round has two phases. At night, whoever has a role with a power acts in secret — protecting, investigating, eliminating, silencing, or placing a bounty. At day, the town sees who died, talks it over, and votes someone out. The town wins if every mafia member is gone; the mafia wins once they equal the town's remaining numbers.
